query:
SELECT 
  f.data,
  f.empresaSlug,
  CAST(f.cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as cat1,
  CAST(f.cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as cat2,
  CAST(f.cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as cat3,
  CAST(f.cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as cat4,
  CAST(f.cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as cat5,
  CAST(f.cat6 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as cat6,
  CAST(f.cat7 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as cat7,
  CAST(f.cat8 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as cat8,
  CAST(f.cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as cat9,
  (CAST(f.cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + 
   CAST(f.cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat6 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + 
   CAST(f.cat7 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat8 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_dia
FROM faturamentos f
WHERE f.empresaSlug = 'barbiero-morumbi'
  AND f.data LIKE '2026-03-%'
ORDER BY f.data;
